rationale: Single think-tank summary page of the MK MONEYVAL evaluation — useful AML evidence, not a recurring signal producer.
Dense English SEE wire on NBRNM decisions and bank news, but largely subscription-gated — clear access first.
Country feed with MK banking/payments/fintech coverage; metered paywall needs human clearance.
Specialist central-bank trade press tracking NBRNM supervisory/fintech moves; subscription-gated.
Public BIS speech archive carrying English NBRNM governor statements — early signal of regulatory initiatives.
One-off EBA PDF opinion on MK CRR equivalence — high-value evidence artifact, parent EBA site is the monitorable source.
Rating-agency entity page with MK banking-sector metrics; registration/gating applies despite MoF mirrors.
Public national news agency English wire relaying MoF/NBRNM regulatory announcements — good MK-to-English bridge.
Third-party enlargement-document mirror; redundant with EC sources, mine once as an archival fallback.
Public-domain, annually refreshed US ITA baseline on MK banking/payment practices; low-frequency but stable.
Static law-firm-network payment-services guide section; useful cross-check, weak as a monitored feed.
Mandatory national e-procurement portal — primary source for MK payment/card/ATM/POS tenders with stated deadlines.
Procurement regulator hub with notices feed, legal framework and open-data search — standalone despite gov.mk siblings.
MoF is both payments-policy owner and major contracting authority; verification failure is soft, re-check liveness.
Sole IPA contracting authority — donor-funded supervisor/PFM modernisation tenders with EU-driven deadlines.
TED with open API is the cleanest machine-readable feed for above-threshold and EU-funded MK notices.
IFI e-procurement portal surfacing EBRD-financed MK systems work absent from the national portal.
Specific World Bank project document/procurement plan — valuable pipeline evidence; the project/STEP hub is the durable source.
Appeals-commission register exposes tender disputes and award-timeline slippage invisible in the notices themselves.
Central bank and payment-system operator/supervisor — core A3 source; failed check is soft, re-verify liveness.
Customs publishes full tender documentation PDFs for EU-alignment-driven IT programmes adjacent to payments/compliance.
Tax authority owns fiscalisation rules governing POS/fiscal-device and card-acceptance obligations — directly in scope.
State fund running the national e-health card programme — card issuance/personalisation demand; re-verify failed URL.
Digital-ID/interoperability policy owner underpinning digital-payment tenders; keep at medium cadence.
National open-data portal with API — bulk structured procurement data avoiding ESJN UI scraping; re-verify liveness.
